transcript.content: Hello, I’m glad you came in today. What brings you in?

Hi. Thanks. Well, I came in because... for a while now, I’ve been convinced that certain people are keeping tabs on me. I work as a financial advisor, and in the arts and finance circles here in Cincinnati, I really feel like people are quietly tracking exactly which clients I meet with. 

And they keep sending me these little signals about it. It'll be through specific invitations I get, or the topics chosen for panels, or even just who ends up sitting near me at events. I mean, I keep telling myself it could all just be a coincidence, but... I can’t really let it go. It's just been weighing on my mind a lot, so I figured I should talk to someone.
Have you used any stimulants like cocaine, meth, or prescription amphetamines recently?
No, I haven't used anything like that. I don't do any drugs at all, just... maybe a little caffeine in the morning, but that's it. Nothing like cocaine or meth or anything prescription.
When did you first start noticing these beliefs that people were tracking or sending you signals?

Well, I'd say it's been going on for... about two months now. Yeah, right around two months ago is when I first started noticing those signals and really feeling like my client meetings were being tracked.
Have you been hearing or seeing things that other people don’t?

No, I haven't experienced anything like that. I don't hear voices or see things that aren't there. It's really just the... the situations I mentioned, the signals and the feeling of being tracked. But no hallucinations or anything.
How have these beliefs affected your work or day-to-day functioning?

Well, I'm still working. But, um... my practice has definitely gotten a bit smaller lately. I just... I end up missing follow-ups, and I've started avoiding some of the public panels I usually participate in. It's just hard to keep up the same level of client contact that I used to manage.
Have you been feeling this way continuously for more than six months?

Well, the specific tracking and signals have only been happening for a couple of months, like I said. But... honestly, things have been changing for a while longer than that. I'd say the changes have been building since I got this recognition from an arts nonprofit. That was a little over two years ago. So, the feelings haven't been exactly the same the whole time, but it's been going on for way more than six months.
Have you been feeling down, depressed, or hopeless for most of the day nearly every day?

No, I wouldn't say that. I don't feel depressed or hopeless, really. It's more just... stressful, dealing with everything else going on. But my mood itself is mostly fine. I don't feel down all day or anything like that.
Have you ever had a period of at least a week where you felt unusually energized or irritable and needed much less sleep than usual?

No, I haven't experienced anything like that. I mean... sometimes I might have a restless night if I'm stressed out, but I don't ever feel super energized or like I don't need to sleep. I definitely still need my normal amount of rest.
Have you ever had a period of at least two weeks where you felt depressed or lost interest or pleasure in most things?

No, I haven't. Like I mentioned a second ago, my mood is mostly fine. I haven't had any long stretches like that where I felt depressed or... you know, just stopped caring about the things I usually enjoy. I still have interest in my normal activities, it's just the other stuff I'm dealing with that gets stressful.
Do you think there is any possible real-world explanation for the tracking and signals you’ve noticed?

I mean... I try to tell myself it could just be coincidence. But that's actually why I came in, because even when I try to rationalize it, I can’t really let it go. 

For a while now, I’ve been convinced that certain people in the arts and finance circles here in Cincinnati are quietly tracking which clients I meet with. And it feels like they're sending me little signals about it—through invitations I receive, specific panel topics, even who happens to sit near me at events. I want to believe there's a normal, everyday explanation for it all, but the feeling that it's deliberate is just too strong. I can't shake it.
Aside from this concern about people tracking you, have you had any other unusual beliefs or experiences, like feeling controlled, specially chosen, or receiving messages meant just for you?

No, I haven't really had anything else like that. I don't feel like anyone is controlling me or... or that I'm specially chosen for anything. It's just the tracking and the signals from those specific groups. Other than that, everything else in my life feels pretty normal.
Have these beliefs been present for at least one month straight without going away?

Yeah, it's been longer than a month. I'd say this whole thing... the feeling that they're tracking my client meetings and sending me those signals, it's been going on for about two months now. It hasn't really stopped or gone away at all during that time.
Have you noticed any problems with your thoughts or speech seeming jumbled, hard to follow, or disconnected?

No, not at all. My thoughts feel completely clear. I mean, I talk to clients all day for my job, and I haven't had any trouble putting my sentences together or staying on track. It's really just the tracking stuff that's been bothering me. Other than that, my mind feels perfectly fine.
Have you noticed a loss of motivation or interest in things compared with how you used to be?

Yeah, I guess I have noticed that. I still get my work done, but it's more in pieces now. I just don't have the same spark. Like, I'll leave client follow-ups sitting there when I normally wouldn't. And outside of work... I've been skipping jazz nights and pickup basketball, and I don't really feel much about missing them. Even when friends check in to ask what's going on, I just give them really short answers. It just feels like talking is more effort than it should be right now.
Have you been hearing voices that other people can’t hear?
No, I haven't noticed anything like that. I don't hear any voices or... you know, anyone talking when no one is actually there. It's really just the tracking and the signals I mentioned before.
Do you ever feel like your thoughts are being broadcast or that other people can hear your thoughts?
No, I don't feel like that. My thoughts are my own... nobody else can hear them. I haven't experienced anything like that, just the tracking and the signals.
Have you long felt uncomfortable or suspicious in close relationships with other people?

No, I... I wouldn't say that. I've never really had a problem trusting my friends or family. I know I mentioned I've been pulling back and giving them short answers lately, but that's really just because I don't have the energy to talk right now. It's not because I'm suspicious of them or uncomfortable being close to them.
Over the past two months, have you felt sad or depressed most of the day nearly every day?

No, I wouldn't say that. I haven't really felt sad or depressed. I mean, I'm definitely tired, and I don't have much energy right now, like I said before... but I don't feel down or sad. My mood is mostly fine, I just haven't been feeling up to doing much.
Have you ever had any behavior so disorganized or unusual that other people thought you were acting very strangely or out of touch with reality?

No, I haven't had anything like that happen. I mean, nobody has told me I'm acting strangely or doing anything unusual. Like I said, I've been a bit quieter and keeping to myself more lately, but... no, I haven't been acting out of touch with reality or anything. I still go about my day normally, for the most part.
Have you noticed a clear drop in how well you’re functioning at work or in your social life compared with before this started?

Yeah, I suppose there's been a drop. I mean, I'm still working as a financial advisor, but... my practice has definitely gotten smaller lately. I just haven't been keeping up the same level of client contact that I used to manage. I've been missing some follow-up calls, and I've started avoiding the public panels I used to speak at. So, yeah, I'm still functioning, but it's just not at the level it was before all this started.
